title: Key pose lấy đà (windup) — thử 2 con: Heo Thần Thoại, Hộ Pháp Cổ Đại
note: Thử nghiệm decision 050 (5): thêm MỘT tranh mới cho mỗi con — WINDUP, khoảnh khắc lấy đà ngay trước đòn đánh (giữa tranh idle và tranh attack đã duyệt). Mỗi sheet = MỘT sinh vật, 3 ô: (1) idle vẽ lại, (2) WINDUP mới, (3) attack vẽ lại. Chỉ ô (2) được dùng; ô (1) và (3) để Gemini hiểu đây là khung trung gian và để đo cỡ khi đặt tranh windup lên đúng canvas / đường chân của bộ key pose cũ. Ảnh 2 = tranh idle đã duyệt, ảnh 3 = tranh attack đã duyệt, ảnh cuối = sơ đồ xếp ô. Mọi pose QUAY PHẢI. Lưu kết quả tên W1.png, W2.png trong thư mục này.

sheets.title: Heo Thần Thoại (pig_thienlong): idle → WINDUP → attack

refs.subject: this exact creature (Heo Thần Thoại) standing in its IDLE pose
the same creature in its ATTACK pose, lunging to the right

the layout of the three cells: one creature per cell, same size, feet on the ground line at the bottom, the body upright in cell 1, crouched low and pulled back to the left in cell 2, stretched forward to the right in cell 3

rows: IDLE pose — the same pose as image 2, standing ready on all four legs

WINDUP pose — the moment just BEFORE the pounce of cell 3: crouched low and coiled like a spring, the weight sitting back on the bent hind legs, the body leaning back to the LEFT, front legs bent under the chest, head lowered and pulled in, both wings raised high and swept back ready to beat, tail curled tight, the same determined frown as image 3, eyes fixed on the right
ATTACK pose — the same pose as image 3, lunging forward to the right in mid-pounce
extra: All three cells show the SAME single creature: Heo Thần Thoại, the creature shown in images 2 and 3. Keep it IDENTICAL to images 2 and 3: the same colours, markings, crown, cape, jewels, wings and body proportions, drawn at the SAME scale as in images 2 and 3.

The three cells are three moments of ONE attack, read left to right: ready, wind up, strike. Cell 2 is the new drawing; it must look like it belongs between cells 1 and 3. EVERY pose faces RIGHT (three-quarter view looking to the right). It is a cute hero creature.
sheets.framing: A character pose sheet: each cell holds the whole creature once, at the SAME size in every cell, its feet resting on the same invisible ground line at the bottom of the cell, about 80 % of the cell height tall (a crouch is lower, a lunge is wider, but never outside the cell). Expressive cartoon acting, clear silhouette. No props, effects, motion lines, dust, stars or text around it.

The three cells are three moments of ONE attack, read left to right: ready, wind up, strike. Cell 2 is the new drawing; it must look like it belongs between cells 1 and 3. EVERY pose faces RIGHT (three-quarter view looking to the right). It is a cute, slightly mischievous monster, never scary.
